name: single_valid_added_key
diffText:
diff --git a/app.py b/app.py
index 111..222 100644
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
+AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"

name: two_valid_added_keys
diffText:
diff --git a/secrets.env b/secrets.env
index 111..222 100644
--- a/secrets.env
+++ b/secrets.env
@@ -1,1 +1,3 @@
+PRIMARY_KEY=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
+SECONDARY_KEY=AKIAZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ

diffText:
